column1: # masu-lint dup (crates/masu-lint/src/dup.rs): copies kept on purpose. kind, then file#name of each copy, then why.
# A copy not listed fails CI; `masu-lint dup --list` shows them all, `--update` drops the gone lines.

column4: # the test's oracle: the code as it was before faces, kept to compare the new code with
# two standalone tools, each over its own Mem (32-bit: a fixed window; 64-bit: a movable limit and code-write marks): the same words, other types
# the fuzz target's own SHA-256 is the reference the JIT's HLE is compared with: sharing the table would share a wrong constant
